Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. The inspection will be visua l and shall be conducted on the basis of the documents submitted by the vendor, including test certificates, warranty documents. 2. Guarantee/ warranty Clause: The supplied items shall be guaranteed against poor workmanship and ma nufacturing defects for a period of 9 months from the date of supply or 6 months from the date of fitment, whichever is earlier. In the event of any defect arising within the warranty period, the vendor shall repair o r replace the defective item(s) free of cost to NSPCL, including all associated transportation and service ch arges. 3. PBG Clause: Not Applicable. 4. Fitment Guarantee: BEML shall certify that the offered BD155 Servo Valve Assy are exact replacement o f/fully interchangeable to the original parts and will fit and function on BEML Make BD155 Dozer, for which these are intended for 1:1 basis without any modification and conform to performance parameters as per OEM specifications. It also be guaranteed that the offered item will be exact replacement of the existing pa rts in respect of fitment, safety & quality. 5. Documents required along with material Supply- The following documents shall be submitted along with the supplied material: a) Guarantee/ Warranty Certificate

b) Fitment/ Interchangeability Certificate 7. Drawing and QP Approval: Not Applicable 8. Payment Terms: 100% payment shall be released within 30 days from the date of receipt and acceptanc e of material at NSPCL Site Stores and submission of all required documents, as applicable. 9. Delivery period and Schedule: Delivery shall be completed within 90 days from award. However, efforts shall be made to expedite the delivery at the earliest. 10. Bid Evaluation Criteria: Bid Evaluation shall be done item wise. 11. Special Instructions: a) Items shall be quoted strictly as per Item long text. b) Any deviation in material specifications must be clarified and approved prior to bid submission. Clarifica tions or deviation requests submitted after bid opening shall not be considered. c) Vendors shall clearly mention the Make, Model, and Part No. for the quoted item(s). d) Alternate Part number shall be accepted subject to fitment guarantee. 12. Technical Support & Service: BEML shall provide technical support and services to ensure proper fitme nt, proper usage, maintenance & satisfactory performance of BD155 Servo Valve Assembly. These services shall be rendered to NSPCL at no additional cost. Bid Participation criteria: 1) This Tender is reserved for OEM/OES only. 2 ) Authorized dealers of OEM may also participate in the bid provided they hav e the valid authorization from the OEM for the particular tender. Authorized deal er/ Channel Partner shall attach the Authorization Certificate / Confirmation fro m the OEM along with the bid documents as proof of authorization. 3 ) Bid submitted by vendor other than OEM/OES/Channel Partner/Authorized de aler shall be liable for rejection. 4) All such vendors were sent mails for participation. The seller or their A/D has to attach the pdf of the mail along with the offer without which the offer is liable for rejection
